questions.q: Which is the correct word equation for aerobic respiration?
questions.why: Aerobic respiration uses glucose and oxygen and produces carbon dioxide and water.

questions.q: Which activity relies mainly on anaerobic respiration?
questions.why: A sprint is short and high-intensity, so energy is released without oxygen.

questions.q: What is a long-term effect of regular endurance training?
questions.why: Training lowers resting heart rate (bradycardia) because stroke volume increases.

questions.q: A runner is still breathing heavily after finishing a 400 m race. Explain why.
questions.model: She worked anaerobically and built up lactic acid. Extra oxygen is needed to remove the lactic acid (EPOC / oxygen debt), so breathing stays high after she stops.
points: Anaerobic work produced lactic acid / oxygen debt
Extra oxygen needed to remove lactic acid (EPOC)
